title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
scope: General structural use of plain and reinforced concrete. NOT a product standard; no ISI Mark / Scheme-I licence is applicable. Common tender error: demanding 'ISI marked concrete as per IS 456'.
notes: Procurement officers frequently demand ISI mark on concrete works citing IS 456. Incorrect.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
scope: Deformed bars/wires Fe415/415D/415S, Fe500/500D/500S, Fe550/550D, Fe600. Fe500D has higher elongation (≥16%) required for seismic ductile detailing (IS 13920).

certification.source: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order

notes: Old 1985 edition still appears in BOQs. Fe500 vs Fe500D mix-up extremely common.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete — Specification

notes: Certification status ambiguous — some projects demand ISI, others accept test certificates only.

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety — Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Safety of IT equipment. Covered under Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS), NOT Scheme-I ISI Mark. Marking uses R-number.
notes: Common error: demanding 'ISI mark / CM/L number' instead of CRS R-number.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries — Safety Requirements — Part 1: Nickel Systems
scope: Portable sealed secondary cells/batteries of nickel systems (NiMH, NiCd). CRS. Separate registration from lithium (Part 2).
notes: Frequent mix-up with Part 2 (lithium). Separate R-numbers required.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries — Safety Requirements — Part 2: Lithium Systems
scope: Portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries (Li-ion, LiPo). CRS. Capacity verification rules updated 2026.

certification.source: Electronics & IT Goods CRO + 2026 capacity order

notes: Most common battery standard. Part 1 vs Part 2 confusion is rampant.

title: Protective Helmet for Two Wheeler Riders — Specification
scope: Protective helmets for two-wheeler riders. Mandatory under Helmet QCO 2020 from 1 June 2021. Amendments 2018 & 2020 often ignored in BOQs.
notes: Amendments 1 & 2 frequently missing from tender specifications.

title: Stainless Steel Utensils — Specification
scope: Stainless steel utensils for cooking, serving and storage. QCO timelines staggered for MSMEs; older editions still cited.
notes: Standard year vs QCO effective date mismatch common.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts — Fineness and Marking

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Part 1: General Requirements
scope: General safety requirements. Being superseded by IS 302 (Part 1):2024 with staggered MSME deadlines.

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Safety — Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Aligned with IEC 60335-1:2020. Current reference under latest Electrical Appliances QCO.

certification.source: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances QCO 2026

notes: Use this edition; older 2008 still appears in many BOQs.
